provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: J index vectors (L234 and analogues) are computed but never used; the t=50 echo uses max(a_50) over the full range instead of max(a_50(I)) (L413) unlike the other panels.
audit_member_text: Repeated snapshot blocks compute J as the finite/in-range model-row set (first at L234) but never use it; interpolation uses the full model columns, and out-of-domain NaNs are replaced by the beach line (first at L240), so missing model coverage is scored as bathymetry rather than rejected.

Copy inconsistency at L413: the t=50 diagnostic prints max(a_50) over the entire analytical array, whereas adjacent t=35,40,45,55,60,65 diagnostics print max(a_XX(I)) over the filtered comparison range.

base_member_text: Model files are loaded with load() then materialized via eval of the filename stem (L174, L186) -- requires the ASCII file to load as a variable named after the file; fails for names starting with digits or containing dots beyond the extension.
audit_member_text: Filename/interface mismatch across L171-L188: load is followed by strfind-based extension stripping and eval of the stripped filename as a MATLAB variable. Paths containing multiple dots, directories, or basenames that are not valid identifiers can fail or select the wrong variable; no loaded-variable validation exists.

base_member_text: The seven snapshot blocks are copy-paste variants differing only in column index and axis limits; per-panel ax1 ymax values (0.04001/0.06001/0.08001/0.1001) encode expected wave growth -- not parameterized.
err/err1 annotations in each panel show the errors of the preceding computation block; for the analytical-only invocation they stay NaN and are suppressed (if ~isnan guards).
The header calls the case both H=0.019 (L33) and H=0.0185 (L67, L204) -- benchmark nominal vs actual amplitude; which applies to analytical_SW.mat is not resolvable here.

audit_member_text: Use-before-supplied interface defect across L161 and L179: the no-argument branch is guarded by nargin<1, so a legal one-argument call enters the else branch and references missing filename2 at L179.

Stale-state defect across L569,L601,L652-L654,L702-L704: the runup section resets err but not err1. If filename1 supplied a last snapshot error and filename2 is empty, that stale err1 is rendered as an ERR Max Runup Amp value in both runup panels.

Inconsistent comparison domain at L666-L683: x/h=0.25 NRMSD filters interpolated model values with ina, but maximum-runup error compares max(y2(ina1)) with max(y2n) over broader arrays; out-of-range NaNs or analytical points outside the model time domain can therefore invalidate or distort the metric.
All NRMSD blocks divide by N and Norm without checking N>0 or nonzero analytical range (first at L248-L249; runup at L626-L627), leaving empty-overlap and constant-reference singularities unguarded.
No pre-index shape checks enforce the documented >=8 columns for a1 or >=3 columns for a2 before accesses spanning L233-L581 and L616-L693.
